Subject: Your breach of contract matter (Project Condor)

Dear Ms. Desai,

Thank you for meeting us on 11 July 2021 about your dispute with M/s Pioneer Motors Ltd. As we understand it, the claim must be filed as a commercial suit. The matter is listed before the Mangaluru Commercial Court.

Our advice is to complete pre-institution mediation before filing the commercial suit. Please collect the mediation request and the statement of accounts and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹6 crore.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
